description.value:
The Hoichi is the most powerful hand-portable airgun on the market. Designed for Arasaka’s Counter Intelligence Division (CID), the Hoichi uses specialized darts propelled by preloaded gas canisters. These darts are slim, granting superior ammo capacity, and can be swapped on the fly thanks to built-in thumb controls. Plus, they make barely any noise when fired, and hit with damage comparable to any other modern hand cannon. The weapon’s overall bulk makes it scarcely passable as a ‘sidearm,’ but for corpo-ninjas zeroing traitors in neon-soaked rain, the Hoichi’s ghostly power is second to none.

Cost: 2,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Foregrip, Magrail Kit (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope & Silencer), Short Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: While wielded in two hands, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality [Foregrip]. This weapon can only load Non-Basic Arrow Ammunition, which unlike other weapons that fire Arrows, is contained within a magazine that must be reloaded like a typical Very Heavy Pistol. This weapon’s magazine can be loaded with up to 4 different types of Ammunition simultaneously, with the user selecting which to use when firing this weapon. Incompatible with Pistol Autosear.

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Magrail Kit (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope & Silencer), Short Scope (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
